discovery_notes: ArtLand 2021-2022 coverage is almost entirely from Disney Pins Blog (owner of DPBStore.com, ArtLand's main retailer) plus Pulse Gallery listings. Keys omit a retailer slug because releases were sold at DPBStore.com AND other select retailers (not exclusives); retailer recorded as claims. Out of window, seen and skipped: Chernabog Jumbo (Oct 2020), Hades Jumbo (Dec 2020), Neo Nouveau S1 (Nov 2020), Princess & Horse S1 (Dec 2020), Glass Pinocchio/Jiminy (2025), Atlantis/Evil Hag glass (2024), Aristocats/Lion King glass (2023), Sorcerer Mickey glass trio (2023), Dumbo Day/Night (2025), Star Wars fine art and helmets (2026). Pixar mystery wave 2 members inferred from feature mentions only. Not yet searched: Princess and Swing, Beauty and the Beast Oval, Coco, Mark Chilcott Pixar, Roger Rabbit, Lion King LE 200, Princess & Friends S1/S2 dates.
